si_4_title.answer: Mapping Neurophysiological Subtypes of Major Depressive Disorder Using Normative Models of the Functional Connectome

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: DIDA-MDD (Disease Imaging Data Archiving - Major Depressive Disorder)
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "used a strictly quality-controlled imaging dataset, including 1148 patients with MDD and 1079 matched HCs from 9 research centers from the DIDA-MDD (Disease Imaging Data Archiving - Major Depressive Disorder Working Group)"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: study_1/Sun2023.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Imaging Dataset and Preprocessing

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: HCs from DIDA-MDD were used to train and validate the normative models (10-fold CV and final model). MDD patients from DIDA-MDD were used to estimate individual deviations and identify subtypes.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "we first estimated the normative models in the HCs under 10-fold cross-validation ... Then, the final normative models were trained on all HCs for the subsequent MDD deviation analyses."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: study_1/Sun2023.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Normative Modeling for FCS

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: The study used 1079 HCs for normative modeling. They performed 10-fold CV (so all were used in 'overall') and then trained the final model on all HCs ('train-phase' for the application model).
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "used ... 1079 matched HCs ... final normative models were trained on all HCs"
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.location: study_1/Sun2023.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Imaging Dataset and Preprocessing

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Calculated weighted mean and pooled SD from site-specific data in Table 1. Range (11-93) obtained from Abstract.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: "1148 patients with MDD and 1079 healthy control participants (ages 11 -93)" (Abstract); Table 1 contains site-specific age means and SDs used for calculation.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Summed sex counts from Table 1 for HCs across all sites (Female=584, Male=495). Percentages calculated based on total N=1079.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: Table 1 contains site-specific sex counts for HCs.
